findings.description: As the fingers pinch the rigid plastic cube, its faces warp and smear (they bend and bulge out of a cube shape) at 00:25-00:50. A light pinch should not deform a hard cube.

A second cube appears coming out of cube 1's right side and overlapping it (00:75-01:00). No hand ever carried it into the frame. Both of the hand's fingers are on cube 1, so the new cube moves into place with no grip.

While the fingers pinch the green cube 3, a new cube pushes out of cube 3's right face, with the two volumes overlapping (frame 00:03.000 at full resolution). Nothing brings it in from outside; it is generated out of the held cube.
A blurred cube comes out of the right side of the just-placed cube 4, overlapping it, while the fingers rest on cube 4's top. It enters the row without being carried in.
The new blue cube appears overlapping the right face of cube 5, with its silhouette merged into cube 5's edge. The index fingertip is on top of cube 5, not on the new cube, when it appears.
A new green cube comes out of the right face of the just-released cube 6, with their volumes overlapping. The hand only reaches it after it has already appeared.
